culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Genichiro Iwata. He attempted to kill his boss, who didn't want to employ him anymore unless he learns how to do management work. He also planned to kill Torazo's driver after Makoto Ukaji blackmailed him. He set a bomb in the driver's car to kill both the driver and the director, and also to frame Torahiko. Kogoro then added that when Torahiko was still in high school, he stole gunpowder in Iwata's fireworks factory to build a bomb. Iwata and Ukaji are arrested.
